prose: David Weiss hosts a YouTube channel called DITRH (Deep in the Rabbit Hole), where he challenges the overwhelming contradictions of mainstream cosmology with heaps of sense-based observations (Zeteticism is the practice of only believing what you have observed yourself).
ext: Topics include the many reasons to doubt NASA, asking "Why the lie?" and the spiritual consequences of such deception. We also consider Antarctica, the Sun behind the Sun, the mysterious moon, and the stars.
